entry.intro: Build runs and groups from numbered tiles, rearrange the whole table and be first to empty your rack. Two to six players; computer players can fill any empty seats.

lobby.share: Share this code, or the invite link, with your friends. Empty seats can be filled by computer players.
lobby.tilesWild: {total} tiles ({colours} x {numbers} x 2 + {count} wildcard). | {total} tiles ({colours} x {numbers} x 2 + {count} wildcards).
lobby.deal: Each player gets {hand}; {pool} start in the pool.

hints.numbers: Tiles run from 1 up to this number.
hints.colours: Each colour has its own hue and shape.
hints.wildcards: Jokers that stand for any tile.
hints.rounds: Scores add up over the rounds.
hints.meld: Needed from your own tiles before you may use the table.
hints.timer: When it runs out the player draws a tile.
hints.playOnMeld: Once your first meld is laid you may rearrange the whole table in the same turn, not from your next.

table.emptyMine: The table is empty. Make a first set from your rack.
table.addToSet: Add the selected tiles to set {n}
table.runsTitle: Colour, then number: good for runs
table.groupsTitle: Number, then colour: good for groups
table.drawTitle: Take a tile from the pool and end your turn

facts.poolTitle: {count} tile in the pool | {count} tiles in the pool

summary.blocked: Nobody could play. {names} had the lowest rack.

status.yourMove: Move tiles from your rack onto the table, or rearrange it. Or draw a tile.
status.makeMeld: Make a first meld of {meld} or more points from your own tiles or draw a tile.
status.makeMeldOpen: Make a first meld of {meld} or more points from your own tiles, then play on with the whole table, or draw a tile.
status.readyPlayed: Ready: {count} tile played. | Ready: {count} tiles played.
status.readyMeldOpen: Ready: first meld worth {points} points, and the table is open.
status.closeScores: Close the scores to carry on.
status.startedWith: Each player started with {count} tile. | Each player started with {count} tiles.
status.waitingHostAgain: Waiting for the host to play again.

hints.jokerStays: A joker on the table stays where it is until you swap in the tile it stands for.
hints.frozen: Until your first meld the sets already on the table cannot be changed.
hints.staysOnTable: A tile that was on the table has to stay on it.
hints.runSplit: The run was split at the second {n}.
hints.jokerReplaced: The joker is replaced: it has moved to a set of its own, so use it in a set this turn.

log.takesOver: {name} takes over from a player who left
log.begins: The game begins: {count} round, {tiles} tiles. | The game begins: {count} rounds, {tiles} tiles.
log.roundStarts: Round {n}: {name} plays first. {hand} tiles each, {inPool} in the pool.
log.melded: {name} melded {count} tile ({points} points) | {name} melded {count} tiles ({points} points)
log.blocked: Nobody can move. {names} wins round {n} with the lowest rack. | Nobody can move. {names} share round {n} with the lowest rack.
log.gameOver: The game is over: {names} wins. | The game is over: {names} share the win.

errors.fewNumbersColours: With so few numbers and colours no run or group can be made. Choose at least {min} numbers or {min} colours.
errors.tooFewTiles: There are only {tiles} tiles, too few to deal {players} players a playable hand (at least {min} each, with a pool as big). Add numbers, colours or wildcards, or remove players.
errors.playOnMeldSetting: Play on after melding must be on or off.
errors.runOneColour: A run is all one colour.
errors.runRepeats: A run cannot repeat a number.
errors.runTooLong: A run cannot be longer than {max} tiles.
errors.runGap: Those numbers are too far apart for the jokers to bridge.
errors.groupOneNumber: A group is all one number.
errors.groupColours: A group needs a different colour for every tile.
errors.groupTooBig: A group cannot have more than {max} tiles (one per colour).
errors.setTooSmall: A set needs at least {min} tiles.
errors.notASet: That is not a set of tiles.
errors.onlyJokers: A set cannot be made only of jokers.
errors.notRunOrGroup: Those tiles do not make a run or a group.
errors.notASetKind: A set is a run (one colour, consecutive numbers) or a group (one number, different colours).
errors.jokerTaken: A joker on the table cannot just be moved: swap in the tile it stands for first.
errors.notATableLayout: That is not a table layout.
errors.tileTwice: A tile appears twice in that layout.
errors.tilesMissing: A tile from the table is missing: everything on the table must stay on it. | {count} tiles from the table are missing: everything on the table must stay on it.
errors.onlyFromRack: You can only add tiles from your own rack.
errors.nothingAdded: You have not added any tiles. Draw a tile instead.
errors.meldShortOpen: Your first meld must be worth at least {meld} points from new sets of your own tiles; those are worth {points}.
errors.meldUsesTable: Before your first meld you cannot use tiles that are already on the table.
errors.meldShort: Your first meld must be worth at least {meld} points from your own tiles; this one is worth {points}.
errors.noTimeLimit: There is no time limit to enforce.
